## Vegan Meringues  

### Ingredients:

- 2 parts aquafaba (juice from garbanzo beans can; can is better than using juice from soaking/cooking beans at home)  
- 3 parts white sugar 

### Directions 

- whip aquafaba for 5 minutes 
- whip for additional 5 minutes, adding sugar 2 TBSP at a time 
- whip for additional 2 minutes 
- bake for 1.5-2.5 hours at 200F
- item
